_about: Party (global.char[0..2]; 1 Kris, 2 Susie, 3 Ralsei, 4 Noelle) when each encounter starts in the original game. Raw code evidence: docs/encounter-parties.json (npm run derive:parties). 'code' = set by the battle room or the triggering cutscene; 'enemy' = the enemy's own code/dialogue references; 'story' = carried over from the surrounding story segment.

ch1-2.note: obj_darkcastle_event: scr_getchar(2) right after encounterno = 2; Ralsei joins later; gamestart sets charauto[2] = 1

ch1-8.note: Forest segment: Susie travels with Lancer (scarelancerevent shows both as NPCs)

ch1-12.note: obj_getsusieevent rejoins scr_getchar(3), then scr_getchar(2); Susie remains automatic until obj_prisonevent resets charauto

ch1-20.note: Susie is a dark marker on Lancer's side (obj_lancerbattle2_event)

ch1-31.note: Susie is an enemy; scr_getchar(3)+scr_getchar(2) only after the battle

ch1-40.note: King: Susie/Ralsei referenced by the boss

ch2-57.note: Mansion: room_dw_mansion_entrance sets Kris, Susie, Ralsei

ch2-58.note: Rollercoaster Berdly: obj_berdlyb_enemy references Susie 12x, Ralsei 10x

ch2-59.note: Queen: Susie 61x, Ralsei 57x in enemy code; scene25 turns actors into followers

ch2-60.note: scr_losechar() after the city Berdly fight; no companions in the alley cutscene or Spamton code

ch2-61.note: Spamton NEO room sets the full party

ch2-61-weird.note: The fountain scene's Weird route retains only Kris; uses the solo encounter strategy

ch2-62.note: Sweet/K_K/Cap'n: Susie 58x, Ralsei 64x; both act in obj_ch2_cyber01

ch2-63.note: Acid tunnel loop Create: scr_losechar(); scr_getchar(3)

ch2-82.note: City Berdly: obj_berdlyb2_enemy references Noelle 44x, Susie/Ralsei never

ch2-82-weird.note: obj_ch2_city_berdly retains Kris and Noelle, with scr_spellget(4, 10) on Weird route

ch3-121.note: Tenna: Susie 34x, Ralsei 70x; both in the BTB06 cutscene

ch3-mantle.note: Board segment: room_shadowmantle's own board controller places the party

ch3-susiezilla.note: room_susiezilla's own controller runs the minigame with Susie

ch4-160.note: obj_dw_church_arena: global.char[0] = 2; char[1] = 0; char[2] = 0 — Susie fights alone

ch5-225.note: obj_heroparent has Flowery-specific Susie sprites; Susie 97x, Ralsei 111x
